<DOCSTRING>
Binds a test scenario to validate the max_age parameter of a signer's unsign method.

Args:
    signer (object): The signer object used for signing and unsigning values.
    ts (datetime): The timestamp used for signing.
    freeze (object): The time freeze object used for ticking time forward.

Returns:
    void: This function does not return a value but asserts conditions to ensure the max_age parameter works correctly.
</DOCSTRING>
